headline: Show the Thinking Behind the Work
body: Admissions committees look beyond finished outcomes. They want to see your research, your creative decisions, and how your ideas evolve.
caption: Preparing an art school portfolio is about presenting your unique perspective. Selection panels value creative risk-taking, curiosity, and iterative development just as much as refined technical skill. Include process work, sketchbook explorations, and the conceptual foundation behind each piece. Curate with intention, and let your authentic creative voice lead the narrative. What is the most ambitious project currently in your portfolio?
